pairs: Et erat vir de Benjamin nomine Cis,
Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish,
the son of a man of Benjamin,
Et erat ei filius vocabulo Saul,
And he had a son called Saul,
et non erat vir de filiis Israël melior illo:
And there was not a man among the sons of Israel better than he was.
ab humero et sursum eminebat super omnem populum.
For he stood head and shoulders above all the people.
Perierant autem asinæ Cis patris Saul:
Now the donkeys of Kish, the father of Saul,
et dixit Cis ad Saul filium suum:
had become lost. And Kish said to his son Saul,
“Take with you one of the servants,
et consurgens vade, et quære asinas.
and rising up, go out and seek the donkeys.”
Qui cum transissent per montem Ephraim
And when they had passed through mount Ephraim,
and through the land of Shalishah,
they crossed also through the land of Shaalim,
and through the land of Benjamin,
Cum autem venissent in terram Suph,
And when they had arrived in the land of Zuph,
dixit Saul ad puerum qui erat cum eo:
Saul said to the servant who was with him,
ne forte dimiserit pater meus asinas,
otherwise perhaps my father may forget the donkeys,
Ecce vir Dei est in civitate hac,
“Behold, there is a man of God in this city,
Now therefore, let us go there.
si forte indicet nobis de via nostra,
For perhaps he may tell us about our way,
because of which we have arrived.”
And Saul said to his servant: “Behold,
Ecce ibimus: quid feremus ad virum Dei?
let us go. But what will we bring to the man of God?
The bread in our sacks has run out.
et sportulam non habemus ut demus homini Dei,
And we have no small gift that we might give to the man of God,
The servant again responded to Saul,
Ecce inventa est in manu mea quarta pars stateris argenti:
“Behold, there is found in my hand a coin of the fourth part of a stater.
Let us give it to the man of God,
so that he may reveal to us our way.”
(Olim in Israël sic loquebatur unusquisque vadens consulere Deum:
(In past times, in Israel, anyone going to consult God would speak in this way,
“Come, and let us go to the seer.”
For one who is called a prophet today,
in past times was called a seer.)
Et dixit Saul ad puerum suum:
And Saul said to his servant:
Et ierunt in civitatem in qua erat vir Dei.
And they went into the city, where the man of God was.
And as they were ascending the slope to the city,
invenerunt puellas egredientes ad hauriendam aquam,
they found some young women going out to draw water.
he is ahead of you. Hurry now.
For he came into the city today,
quia sacrificium est hodie populi in excelso.
since there is a sacrifice for the people today, on the high place.
statim invenietis eum antequam ascendat excelsum ad vescendum,
you should find him immediately, before he ascends to the high place for the meal.
neque enim comesurus est populus donec ille veniat:
And the people will not eat until he has arrived.
et deinceps comedunt qui vocati sunt.
and thereafter those who were called will eat.
For you will find him today.”
And they ascended into the city.
Cumque illi ambularent in medio urbis,
And as they were walking in the midst of the city,
Samuel appeared, advancing to meet them,
so that he might ascend to the high place.
Dominus autem revelaverat auriculam Samuelis ante unam diem quam veniret Saul,
Now the Lord had revealed to the ear of Samuel, one day before Saul had arrived,
Hac ipsa hora quæ nunc est,
“Tomorrow, at the same hour that it is now,
cras mittam virum ad te de terra Benjamin,
I will send to you a man from the land of Benjamin.
et unges eum ducem super populum meum Israël:
And you shall anoint him to be the leader over my people Israel.
et salvabit populum meum de manu Philisthinorum,
And he will save my people from the hand of the Philistines.
For I have looked with favor upon my people,
venit enim clamor eorum ad me.
because their outcry has reached me.”
And when Samuel had caught sight of Saul,
“Behold, the man about whom I spoke to you.
This one shall rule over my people.”
Accessit autem Saul ad Samuelem in medio portæ,
Then Saul drew near to Samuel,
at the middle of the gate,
where is the house of the seer?”
Ascend before me to the high place,
so that you may eat with me today.
And I will send you away in the morning.
et omnia quæ sunt in corde tuo indicabo tibi.
And I shall reveal to you everything that is in your heart.
Et de asinis quas nudiustertius perdidisti,
And concerning the donkeys, which were lost the day before yesterday,
Et cujus erunt optima quæque Israël?
And all the best things of Israel, for whom should they be?
nonne tibi et omni domui patris tui?
Will they not be for you and for all your father’s house?”
ait: Numquid non filius Jemini ego sum de minima tribu Israël,
“Am I not a son of Benjamin, the least tribe of Israel,
et cognatio mea novissima inter omnes familias de tribu Benjamin?
and are not my kindred the last among all the families from the tribe of Benjamin?
quare ergo locutus es mihi sermonem istum?
So then, why would you speak this word to me?”
brought them into the dining room,
et dedit eis locum in capite eorum qui fuerant invitati:
and he gave them a place at the head of those who had been invited.
For there were about thirty men.
And Samuel said to the cook,
“Present the portion that I gave to you,
et præcepi ut reponeres seorsum apud te.
and which I instructed you to set apart beside you.”
Then the cook lifted up the shoulder,
and he placed it before Saul.
set it before you and eat.
quia de industria servatum est tibi quando populum vocavi.
For it was preserved for you intentionally, when I called the people.”
Et comedit Saul cum Samuele in die illa.
And Saul ate with Samuel on that day.
Et descenderunt de excelso in oppidum,
And they descended from the high place into the town,
et locutus est cum Saule in solario:
and he spoke with Saul in the upper room.
And he set out a bed for Saul in the upper room,
And when they had risen in the morning,
and it now began to be light,
Samuel called to Saul in the upper room,
so that I may send you on.”
Cumque descenderent in extrema parte civitatis,
And as they were descending to the very limit of the city,
Dic puero ut antecedat nos et transeat:
“Tell the servant to go ahead of us, and to continue on.
But as for you, stay here a little while,
so that I may reveal the word of the Lord to you.”
